landing.heading: Your story can change this vote.
landing.skip: Just want to sign the petition?
landing.body:
75,000 Philadelphia self-employed workers are facing a surprise tax increase in 2026. Personal testimony from constituents is what moves Council members to act.
Answer a few questions — we'll turn your words into scripts you can use to email, call, or testify.

action.heading: How do you want to take action?
action.sub: We'll use your story to generate whichever script you need — in your own words.
action.email_desc: Personalized letter to your district rep
action.phone_desc: Quick talking guide for a 2-minute call
action.all_desc: Email, phone script, and testimony — all three

support.heading: Sign the Petition
support.sub: Add your name to show Council the scale of support for Bill No. 251026.
support.cant_attend: Can't attend — but want to do more?
support.step1: Share this guide with other self-employed Philadelphians who may not know about the 2026 tax increase.
support.step2: Call your council member's office. You don't need a script — just say "I support Bill 251026 and want it brought to a vote."
support.step3: Show up to a town hall: April 28, April 30, or May 5 — all 6–7:30 PM.
support.president_note:
Council President Kenyatta Johnson controls what comes to a floor vote.
Phone: (215) 686-3412  |  City Hall, Room 580
Even a 2-minute call from a constituent makes a difference.
